description: This file defines the AppDatabase class using Room for local data persistence in an Android application. It specifies entities, DAO accessors, and a factory method for creating database instances.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class extending RoomDatabase, providing access to NoteDao and SyncStateDao, and a companion object for creating database instances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: A static method that initializes and returns an AppDatabase instance using Room.databaseBuilder with a specified context, database class, and name.
